title: Iran conflict z>2 -> MOS abs return lag3
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Iran conflict event count 20d z-score > 2 leads MOS absolute returns by 3 days (+) as Gulf escalation raises fertilizer volatility regardless of direction; trade long MOS straddle-proxy 5d [gdelt.irn.conflict_events -> finance.MOS.abs_return] (parent: R2-0044)

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.conflict_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long MOS next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 7 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Iran conflict event count 20d z-score > 2 leads MOS signed log returns by 7 days (+) as the abs_return result is trivially long-biased; directional control to test whether the volatility signal has any sign [gdelt.irn.conflict_events -> finance.MOS.log_return] (parent: R2-0143)
